sql.if: AND (client_accounts.display_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query}, '%') OR client_accounts.phone LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query}, '%'))

mapper.select: SELECT client_accounts.id, client_accounts.display_name AS displayName, CASE WHEN client_accounts.phone IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CONCAT(LEFT(client_accounts.phone, 3), '•••', RIGHT(client_accounts.phone, 3)) END AS maskedPhone, COUNT(table_sessions.id) AS sessionCount, MAX(table_sessions.created_at) AS lastVisitedAt FROM client_accounts LEFT JOIN table_sessions ON table_sessions.client_account_id = client_accounts.id WHERE client_accounts.store_id = #{storeId} GROUP BY client_accounts.id, client_accounts.display_name, client_accounts.phone ORDER BY lastVisitedAt DESC, client_accounts.id DESC

SELECT client_accounts.id, client_accounts.display_name AS displayName, CASE WHEN client_accounts.phone IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CONCAT(LEFT(client_accounts.phone, 3), '•••', RIGHT(client_accounts.phone, 3)) END AS maskedPhone, COUNT(table_sessions.id) AS sessionCount, MAX(table_sessions.created_at) AS lastVisitedAt FROM client_accounts LEFT JOIN table_sessions ON table_sessions.client_account_id = client_accounts.id WHERE client_accounts.store_id = #{storeId} AND client_accounts.id = #{customerId} GROUP BY client_accounts.id, client_accounts.display_name, client_accounts.phone
SELECT phone FROM client_accounts WHERE store_id=#{storeId} AND id=#{customerId}

SELECT table_sessions.public_id AS publicId, dining_tables.code AS tableCode, table_sessions.status, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE orders.table_session_id=table_sessions.id) AS orderCount, payments.status AS paymentStatus, payments.amount AS paymentAmount, unpaid_records.status AS unpaidStatus, unpaid_records.amount AS unpaidAmount, table_sessions.created_at AS openedAt, table_sessions.closed_at AS closedAt FROM table_sessions INNER JOIN dining_tables ON dining_tables.id=table_sessions.table_id LEFT JOIN payments ON payments.table_session_id=table_sessions.id LEFT JOIN unpaid_records ON unpaid_records.table_session_id=table_sessions.id WHERE dining_tables.store_id=#{storeId} AND table_sessions.client_account_id=#{customerId} ORDER BY table_sessions.created_at DESC, table_sessions.id DESC

mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM audit_logs WHERE audit_logs.store_id=#{storeId}
